1.consolidated_definition: Con beneficio, el que obtiene el medianero al cuidar una vaca recién parida y su cría, utilizando la leche como si fuera propia.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The person who benefits, the one who cares for a newly calved cow and its calf, utilizing the milk as if it were their own, in exchange for compensation.
